verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt at librechat.ai, described as a "curated map of the LibreChat documentation for language models and coding agents." A second probe confirms a markdown version of the docs at /docs.md, and doc pages are also served as .md URLs, so an agent can be pointed straight at agent-oriented docs. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents actually consuming these docs, and evidence of fuller agent-doc variants such as an llms-full.txt dump.
